description: This file defines a React functional component 'CostTrackingSettings' that manages cost tracking configurations, including fetching and updating discount configurations, rendering UI for managing provider discounts, and handling user interactions such as adding or removing discounts.

methods.name: fetchDiscountConfig
methods.description: Fetches the discount configuration from the backend server.

methods.name: saveDiscountConfig
methods.description: Saves the updated discount configuration to the backend server.

methods.name: handleAddProvider
methods.description: Handles adding a new provider discount to the configuration.

methods.name: handleModalCancel
methods.description: Resets the modal form and closes the add provider modal.

methods.name: handleFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the add provider form.

methods.name: handleRemoveProvider
methods.description: Removes a provider discount after user confirmation.

methods.name: handleDiscountChange
methods.description: Updates discount percentage for a provider.
